tickets.title: Complete household profile update
tickets.text:
Refresh the household profile using the latest client-provided information. Confirm household members, employment status, dependents, key contacts, income sources, recurring obligations, benefits, risk preferences, and communication preferences. Note any planning implications that should be routed to the advisory team.

Update planning records for Arlen Nettlewhisk’s shift from his W-2 role at Silver Marmot Analytics to sole-member LLC self-employment at Pocket Lantern Studio, effective 2024-05-10.

subTasks.title: Collect household changes
subTasks.text: Request updates for household members, employment, dependents, contact information, outside advisors, and major life changes since the prior profile review.

subTasks.title: Update planning assumptions
subTasks.text: Record changes to income, savings, spending, insurance coverage, benefits, goals, and risk tolerance in the planning record.

subTasks.title: Advisor review of planning impacts
subTasks.text: Review the updated household profile for retirement income, tax-aware investment, equity compensation, or estate coordination implications that warrant follow-up.

tickets.evidence: For the business launch profile and retirement plan analysis, Arlen asked Apricot Compass Wealth Advisory to update planning records for his shift to Pocket Lantern Studio self-employment

tickets.title: Review equity award details
tickets.text: Compare retirement plan choices for Arlen Nettlewhisk using forecast net profit, no current employees, and his preferred contribution range.
tickets.evidence: compare retirement plan choices using forecast net profit, no current employees, and his preferred contribution range

tickets.title: Prepare cash-flow schedule for business estimated taxes
tickets.text: Prepare a cash-flow schedule for Arlen Nettlewhisk to set aside taxes from Pocket Lantern Studio’s irregular client retainers. Coordinate with CPA Lila Juniperjingle with permission before his next estimated payment.
tickets.evidence: Arlen requested a cash-flow schedule for setting aside taxes from irregular client retainers and permission-based coordination with CPA Lila Juniperjingle before his next estimated payment

tickets.title: Follow up on missing business account opening records
tickets.text: Follow up on the missing Pocket Lantern Studio operating account opening records at Teacup Comet Bank required for the team to review the account. Obtain the signature card, first statement, and online balance export in the secure portal.
tickets.evidence: A follow-up is needed on missing business account opening records because the team could not review the Pocket Lantern Studio operating account without the Teacup Comet Bank signature card, first statement, and online balance export in the secure portal

tickets.title: Follow up on income forecast discrepancy
tickets.text: Follow up on the discrepancy between the call projection of $168,000 annual gross revenue for Pocket Lantern Studio and the Marzipan Meadow Bookkeeping worksheet of $132,000, which excluded one signed retainer.
tickets.evidence: A follow-up is needed on the income forecast discrepancy because the call projection showed annual gross revenue of $168,000, while the Marzipan Meadow Bookkeeping worksheet showed $132,000 and excluded one signed retainer

tickets.title: Resolve duplicated portal transactions
tickets.text: Follow up on the duplicated portal transactions following the Teacup Comet Bank connection change from personal checking to business checking.
tickets.evidence: Arlen reported duplicated portal transactions after the Teacup Comet Bank connection changed from personal checking to business checking; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-06.
